author: did:kash:21UhTqUdjZYWvw3jPz5emqdYskRqdQBLofo3MupZN3Jt
title: Internship credit (SAMPLE rule)
purpose: The campus awards the internship course's credit hours for a supervised internship its own record shows was completed. SAMPLE figures until the campus supplies its own.

outcome.grants: The internship course's three credit hours (SAMPLE course code).

reasons.text: The internship record shows the weeks approved and the final review signed: the credit is awarded.
The record does not yet show every approved week, the hours, or the final review.
The coordinator does not award the credit, for the reason they give.
The coordinator awards part of the credit, for the reason they give.

contest.how: Ask the department office for a review; the head of department, who did not make the first decision, answers.

anotherWay: A signed paper logbook and the academic supervisor's letter, handed to the department office, are read by the coordinator in person.

criteria.label: The weeks approved by the site supervisor, and the final review signed
criteria.purpose: The credit is for a supervised internship: each week approved where it happened, and reviewed by the academic supervisor at the end.

condition.feel: some r in receipts satisfies count(r.weeksApproved) >= minWeeks and r.hoursStated >= minHours and r.finalReviewOn <= date(asOf)

basis.title: HEC: professional certifications and internships for undergraduate degrees (2025-09-25)
basis.clause: at least three credit hours of supervised internship

criteria.label: The course this credit counts toward
criteria.purpose: The credit is recorded against one course; the student names the course code their programme lists.

answer.statement: The internship counts toward this course on my programme.

answers.text: The credit is the campus's own course credit, and only the campus keeps the record of its own supervised internships; the paper route covers anyone whose record the campus does not hold.
